:::{#thm-deriv-matrix-vector}

#### Vector-derivative of a matrix-vector product

If $\matr{A}$ is an $m \times q$ matrix that is constant with respect to $\vcoef$,
and $\vecf{v} = \vecf{v}(\vcoef)$ is a $q \times 1$ vector
that depends on the $p \times 1$ vector $\vcoef$,
then:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vcoef} (\matr{A}\vecf{v})}_{p \times m} =
\underbrace{\paren{\deriv{\vcoef} \vecf{v}}}_{p \times q}
\underbrace{\tp{\matr{A}}}_{q \times m}
$$

:::
